About MOD LUXURY

A Better Luxury Experience

MOD LUXURY was built around a simple idea: premium service should feel personal, seamless and crafted around you.

From the vehicle you drive to the content you create, every detail is handled by our Toronto team — thoughtfully, discreetly and to one exacting standard. There are no counters to queue at and no call centres to navigate. You speak with people who know the city, know the craft, and take genuine pride in getting every detail right.

That philosophy shapes everything we do. Each engagement begins with listening: where you are going, what the occasion calls for, and how you would like it to feel. From there, we arrange the rest — so the experience unfolds exactly as it should, from the first conversation to the final farewell.

Drive Your Passion.

The MOD LUXURY Standard

Service that is arranged around you, from start to finish

Personal, Concierge-Style Service

Every booking is handled personally by our team — one point of contact, attentive communication, and arrangements shaped around your schedule rather than ours. It is the ease of a private concierge, applied to every journey.

Delivered Across Toronto

Your vehicle arrives where you need it, prepared and ready — at your home, your hotel, your office or the terminal. We serve the Greater Toronto Area, including:

Downtown TorontoYorkvilleEtobicokeNorth YorkVaughanToronto Pearson Airport (YYZ)

More Than Rentals

MOD LUXURY is a house of automotive services under one roof — a content creation studio, photography & videography, and specialist automotive services alongside our rental collection, each delivered to the same standard.

Our Craft

Prepared with intention, presented with pride

A luxury experience is never an accident. It is the sum of a hundred small decisions, each made with care.

Behind every handover is a disciplined process: meticulous preparation, careful inspection, and presentation finished to showroom standard. Behind every production is the same discipline — considered creative direction, professional equipment, and a team that understands how a vehicle should look, sound and feel on camera.

It is this quiet consistency that our clients return for: the confidence that whichever service they choose, it will be handled properly — and personally.

I.

Personal by Design

No scripts and no hand-offs. You deal directly with the team who will look after you, from your first enquiry to your return.

II.

Seamless in Practice

Delivery, timing and detail arranged in advance, so all that is left for you to do is enjoy the drive — or the shoot.

III.

Exacting in Standard

Preparation and presentation held to one uncompromising benchmark, across every vehicle and every service we offer.
